title: Use Bootstrap Ledger now and Native Ledger Service later
decision: The same conceptual ledger standard must support a file-backed bootstrap implementation and a later native service/API implementation.

title: Use JSONL/JSON, not Markdown as canonical ledger state
decision: The active bootstrap ledger must be JSONL records plus JSON projections; Markdown is optional debug export only.

title: Use operating capsules for weak agents
decision: Agents must normally read compact state and operating capsules instead of the entire ledger/schema/history.

title: Use PlanUnit as bridge to work nodes
decision: Standardized Plans expose stable PlanUnits; a later compiler generates NodeSeeds and WorkNodes.

title: Do not embed final work nodes in Plans
decision: Plans are canon; work nodes are execution strategy and should be generated artifacts.

title: Goal Mode is phase-specific in bootstrap
decision: Conversational spec creation can be ordinary Codex chat; compile, audit, migration, indexing, and governance seal use Goal Mode.

title: Spec Lock only at final seal
decision: Governance artifacts are refreshed only after canonical docs and generated indexes stop changing.

title: Retired experiments are excluded
decision: Do not use or cite failed prompt-packet/tranche mechanics as the new design basis.

title: Use simple automatic GUI classification
decision: Use a simple agent-inferred gui_related boolean on design atoms, PlanUnits, indexes, node-readiness, and future NodeSeeds/WorkNodes. Do not require user annotation and do not expose granular GUI/UI/icon/image routing in the product UI.

title: Generate node-readiness, not WorkNodes
decision: The current PlanUnit index phase may produce a node-readiness report, but must not create WorkNodes or executable build tasks. NodeSeed candidates and WorkNodes are future phases after Plans and the compiler contract are complete.

title: Implementation-readiness plan polish
decision: The initial owner docs are valid but require implementation-readiness polish before existing-Plans conversion: explicit file layout, validator, PlanUnit grammar, migration artifact, node-readiness, and thread handoff contracts.
